newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebels free Turkish soldier prisoners.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebels free Turkish soldier prisoners.

text.p: Kurdish guerrillas have released two Turkish soldiers they held prisoner in the mountains of northern Iraq for more than a year, Turkish border officials said on Tuesday.
"They came back across the border this morning," said Huseyin Avni Mutlu, the civilian in charge of the Habur border crossing with Iraq.
He said the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels group had set the pair free on Monday in the northern Iraqi town of Duhok.
"They looked healthy to me but they were a little thin," he told Reuters by telephone.
The PKK still holds at least five other Turkish soldiers abducted early last year in a guerrilla raid on a security post near the Iraqi border.
